programme.desc: The Fetal Kick Catalyst. Feeling his baby kick sends Howard on a baby-items buying binge with Raj, Sheldon and Amy host a brunch, and Penny is invited to a sci-fi convention. S10, Ep6

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Veracity Elasticity. Amy fibs about repairs being made to her apartment. Later, they present an episode of 'Fun with Flags' in Penny's apartment. S10, Ep7

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Brain Bowl Incubation. A successful gene experiment leaves Sheldon excited to procreate with Amy. Raj is reluctant to reveal what his new woman does for a living. S10, Ep8

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Geology Elevation. A coworker's MacArthur Genius fellowship award leaves Sheldon stone cold jealous. Howard finds a remote-control Stephen Hawking action figure. S10, Ep9

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Property Division Collision. A divide develops between Sheldon and Leonard when divvying up their shared belongings. Raj and Stuart battle to provide Bernadette the most help. S10, Ep10

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Birthday Synchronicity. While Sheldon and Amy celebrate Amy's birthday, Howard and Bernadette welcome their new Baby Wolowitz. S10, Ep11

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Holiday Summation. Sheldon and Amy visit Leonard and Penny for the first time since the holidays and share details about their terrible trip to Texas. S10, Ep12

programme.title: The Fall Of Diddy
programme.desc: Untouchable. Sean Combs rises to new heights, soon reaching billionaire status. However, behind his empire, people come forward with allegations of mistreatment. S1, Ep3

programme.title: The Fall Of Diddy

programme.title: Fighting Man of the Plains
programme.desc: 1949. Western. Stars Randolph Scott, Bill Williams & Victor Jory. Jim Dancer, one of Quantrill's Raiders, stages attacks on Kansas on behalf of the fallen Confederacy.

programme.title: Budgie
programme.desc: Do Me A Favour. Stars: Adam Faith, Iain Cuthbertson & Lynn Dalby. Hazel's cousin Herbert arrives in London and Budgie is bribed into taking him on a guided tour.

programme.title: Three Came Home
programme.desc: 1950. True story of a woman imprisoned in several Japanese war camps. She struggles to protect her young son. Stars Claudette Colbert.

programme.title: Miss MacTaggart Won't Lie Down
programme.desc: 1966. Comedy. Directed by Francis A Searle. Stars Barbara Mullen and Eric Woodburn. A spinster has been proclaimed dead - but is very much alive...

programme.title: Rock You Sinners
programme.desc: 1957. Musical. A disc-jockey gets his own TV show and becomes a star. Starring Jackie Collins and featuring many musical acts of the 50's.

programme.title: Honey West
programme.desc: 1965. Invitation To Limbo. Crime series produced by Aaron Spelling & stars Anne Francis. An electronics firm hires Honey to find an industrial spy who has been leaking company secrets.

programme.title: The Adventures of Jim Bowie
programme.desc: Broomstick Wedding. 1956. Stars Scott Forbes & Mike Connors. An angry farmer mistakenly believes that Jim is the man who 'dishonoured' his daughter and has to right his wrong by marrying her.

programme.title: The More the Merrier
